“I’m going to sell that.”

The item: still there.
The pile: getting bigger.
The weekend: always the next one. 😅

angles.hook: Already picked the yacht. Hasn’t lifted a finger.
cards: Already picked the yacht. Hasn’t lifted a finger.
They hear “good idea” and start planning their retirement.
The celebration has a date. The first step doesn’t.
You’re talking about getting started. They’re dividing up the millions.
Dream big. Then do one small thing today.
angles.cta: Tag your big-picture friend. Share with their reality check.

angles.caption:
The yacht has a name. The first task hasn’t been started. 😂

We all know someone who skips straight to the victory speech. Dream big—but give the dream a first step.

Tag your big-picture friend, and share this with the one who keeps them grounded.
angles.textPost:
The idea: five minutes old.
The celebration: fully planned.
The work: hasn’t started. 😂

Know someone who jumps straight to the best-case scenario before lifting a finger? Tag your big-picture friend and share this with their reality-check person.

rules.defaultStyle: centered larger owner photo, deep teal, cream bold native text, yellow accent, no header branding
rules.copy: General relatable behavior, understandable without watching the film. Vary the habit and exaggeration. Do not use the film's characters or scene-specific jokes.
rules.clutterTone: Friendly offer to help. Describe visible habits without labeling or diagnosing a person.
